purpose: User-approved dark visual-direction catalog; generated concepts, not implementation
sharedStyle:
Use case: ui-mockup. Approved AudioForge Studio premium precision-workstation concept, now in its FINAL USER-REQUESTED BLACK THEME. Realistic full-window macOS desktop screenshot at 16:10, high-resolution crisp typography. NOT an implemented application screenshot; design asset only. Preserve the NEW distinctive visual language from the supplied Titanium reference, not the earlier rejected plain black wireframes.
ABSOLUTE DARK THEME: all backgrounds black/near-black. Canvas #05070A. Titlebar, transport and inspector #10151B. Recessed controls #191F28; text soft silver #D7DEE8, secondary #8D9BAB, dividing lines #28303A. No white/light/porcelain/silver background surfaces anywhere, including dropdowns, inspector, dialogs, titlebar or footer. No overall image brightness tricks, neon, glow, texture, cloudy gradients or frosted glass. Skin must be comfortable for subdued studio light. White allowed ONLY as tiny waveform high-frequency detail, text or icons, never large fill areas.
NEW APPROVED VISUAL LANGUAGE: stronger expertly typeset mode belt with six evenly spaced modes and consistent tiny line icons, active mode solid deep-petrol rounded segment with silver text. Titlebar document hierarchy. Inspector is an instrument rack with large primary numeric readings, compact supporting labels, aligned two-column groups and disciplined spacing; not a uniform list of tiny boxes and not web cards. Transport deck has a prominent precise clock and dark-petrol circular Play, quieter selection/readout strip. Calm hierarchy from subtle surface shifts, exact spacing, subdued 1px rules and 5–7px radii. Expert density, all controls legible. Same six modes exactly: Library, DJ Prep, Restore, Warp, Draw, Analyze.
SHARED LAYOUT: slim titlebar with AudioForge Studio, Tribal Spirit, Working copy; navigation belt below; top-of-editor full-track OVERVIEW with visible viewport; contextual toolstrip; large central task canvas with stereo L/R where relevant; right contextual inspector; bottom transport/time/selection/zoom/source unchanged; narrow History drawer. No giant persistent left mode sidebar. Library alone uses folder sidebar. No new Session View. UI copy professional English.
SIGNATURE SIGNAL: 3Band full-track overview and detailed waveforms, frequency-informed MULTILAYER envelopes: cobalt/blue bass-body, amber mid-frequency details, pearl-white fine high-frequency spikes. NOT rainbow gradients, NOT time segments colored randomly, NOT colored phrases pretending to be signal. Layers aligned in time within stereo, crisp leading attacks, decaying tails, quiet gaps, irregular believable detail. Small legend Low blue / Mid amber / High pale silver. Source transient ticks and Warp anchor diamonds are separate shapes/lane. Cues POINTS and phrase REGIONS independent. All data synthetic illustrative. Keep original audio safe; no fabricated perfect scores.
